saw_lines: Juice buyers grab the bottle already in their fridge, then pick the same flavor again without reading the label.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where a buyer decides to try something new.
Your 18 ads carry no proof number, so collect one you can defend, like a review count or bottles shipped, and open three new ads with it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 19 Oct 2026
points: None of your 18 ads carries a proof number, so new buyers have no reason to trust an unfamiliar brand. Collect one number you can defend, like a review count or bottles shipped, and open three new ads with it.
0 of 15 copy ads carry an offer, so a new buyer has no reason to act today. Put a first order offer in the opening line of three new ads, and keep it there in every variation.

Your 15 copy ads open with 12 different stories, and the biggest leads just 2 ads. Each new story starts cold, so none gets enough repeats to learn from. Build the next batch from the butter yellow and banana openings.
5 of your ads have run 60 days or longer, yet every new variation starts from zero. Build three more variations of the oldest winner, the butter yellow ad, with a new product shot.

ads_1: Butter yellow and banana hooks with one proof number and a first order offer
